title: Xiaomi Wi-Fi 7 Dual-Band Router BE3600 2-Pack $102 Delivered @ Xiaomi
body:
Deal: Xiaomi Wi-Fi 7 Dual-Band Router BE3600 2-Pack $102 Delivered @ Xiaomi

[SS625] $159 rmb + shipping from taobao …. not very bad deal thou
[Awsam] Does Xiaomi have an offical taobao store?
[JsMIT] Can these be linked and used as a Mesh network with single ssid?
[Sage222] yep they can! wired backbone too if you want!
[Sage222] bargain! this a nice bits of kit got 3 of them in mesh! fast enough wireless VR to my meta quest 3!
[mckayver] Fck yeah. I've got the xiaomi ax6000 in through the wall mode and it does the whole house easily. Xiaomi routers are the best.
[Salmando] No issues at all? Configurability?
I've been pretty disappointed in the Google Nest ones, even though they've been reliable
[mckayver] Absolutely flawless. I've had it maybe 3 years now and the only times it's been rebooted was when we have power cut black out in storms. One thing the ax6000 doesn't have usb port which would be nice. The new model xiaomi 7000 has wifi 7 and usb 3.0. Aliexpress, definitely worth it.
[internet-stranger] No 6ghz support and no OpenWRT firmware support (yet).
Still good cheap devices.
[BargainBenno] Currently have mercusys mr90x wifi 6 router. I have two set up as a mesh. Will these be better with being Wi-Fi 7 as opposed to Wi-Fi 6 as I have a 12 pieces of equipment attached to my router and sometimes now I get congestion
[Vermin76] Got 4 of these with the last special, had to separate the 2.4 & 5ghz channels to keep my google and other iot devices connected, they'd keep disconnecting. Also have the 2 that use wireless backhaul drop out every couple of days; the wired backhaul seems solid. And yeah reading reviews since I got them they don't have auto reconnect if the internet drops out, the base needs to be restarted, I haven't had this happen yet though.
[Tarun Tuli] Is it good to replace optus provided router and mesh?
Just for general use….
[StingyMan] If your existing stuff is working for you (and hitting your plan speeds) then no. If it is not, then a good idea to replace (or save a few dollars by lowering your plan if you don't need the speed)
[JsMIT] Are you FTTN? if you are then you'll still an optus modem then switching off the modem wifi and then connect to these via ethernet cable from modem to router and use the wifi/mesh from the new router. If you're FTTP then you can connect directly to these and it will all just work.
[keejoonc] I've got two of these. No complaints with the speed, but the satellite router sometimes drops off and I have to restart the router to get it to connect again.
[Tarun Tuli] Got HFC, I think i can connect to nbn modem and get it going but the question is optus has peovided a modem and 2 booster and i kind of get 500mb every in my house on a 500mb plan with wired backhaul
Will 102 make anything better
[Tarun Tuli] https://www.bunnings.com.au/eero-amazon-6-mesh-wi-fi-6-route…
Eero on 199..surely office work can price match it….
Not sure which is better will leave it to expert
[Grubbington] Do these work with TPG FTTC? or even the pro, can't seem to find anywhere that says if they have the PPoE and vlan2 support.
[andresampras] Over an hour and still no comment about China spying?
Step down your game, OzBargain!
Putting my 🍿 away….for now.
[bboarder] ok well I had the xiaomi ax9000. adguard was picking up a lot of traffic to random chinese sites. sold that spying crap and bought a huawei instead. Jokes I mean Flint 2 :p
[alz] I'm having issues with mercusys h70x 3 pack going through walls in a tiny 3br home. Will this assist by chucking it in the mesh?
[boyashley] Will these work with TPG straight to NBN black box? Or will I need to go through a router?
[h3blade] for tpg YOU will have to support POE，I use it to extend my default tpg free tp link router. it works well than my previous generation xiaomi.
my old Xiaomi get disconnected all the time but this one worked perfectly
[uccoffee] Been $102 for a few weeks already, bought 6 and return 2
